title: Choosing a university
instructions: Leo ve annesi iki üniversite arasında karar vermeye çalışıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; hangi bilginin hangi üniversiteye ait olduğunu karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: mum
script.text: So, Leo, have you decided? Northfield or Westbridge?

script.speaker: leo
script.text: Not yet. Northfield is a better university for engineering. It's number three in the country.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: Westbridge is number twelve. But it's only an hour from home, and Northfield is five hours away.

script.speaker: mum
script.text: What about the cost of living?

script.speaker: leo
script.text: Northfield is a big city, so rent is expensive. At Westbridge, I could live in student rooms for less than half the price.

script.speaker: mum
script.text: Did you like the campuses when you visited?

script.speaker: leo
script.text: Westbridge was beautiful, with a lake. Northfield was in the city centre, so it was a bit noisy. But Northfield has a great sports centre.

script.speaker: mum
script.text: It's your decision. What's most important to you?

script.speaker: leo
script.text: Honestly, my future job. A degree from Northfield will help me more.

script.speaker: mum
script.text: Then I think you know the answer. We'll visit you, even if it's five hours away!

questions.prompt: Which university is better for engineering?
questions.feedback: Mühendislik için Northfield daha iyi; ülkede üçüncü.
questions.evidence: Northfield is a better university for engineering.

questions.prompt: How far is Westbridge from Leo's home?
questions.feedback: Westbridge evden sadece bir saat; Northfield beş saat.
questions.evidence: But it's only an hour from home

questions.prompt: What is good about living at Westbridge?
options: It has a great sports centre.
questions.feedback: Westbridge'deki öğrenci odaları yarı fiyattan daha ucuz.
questions.evidence: I could live in student rooms for less than half the price.

questions.prompt: What did Leo NOT like about the Northfield campus?
options: It was far from the city.
questions.feedback: Northfield şehir merkezinde olduğu için biraz gürültülüydü.
questions.evidence: so it was a bit noisy.

questions.prompt: Which university will Leo probably choose?
questions.feedback: Gelecekteki işi için Northfield diploması daha faydalı; büyük ihtimalle orayı seçecek.
questions.evidence: A degree from Northfield will help me more.
